meta.note: VNG Interconnect / Header Improvement Project split, Baird 2026-11-07. P5990 gets the northern line only. The full route for the new Header Improvement Project row waits in candidate_routes/header-improvement-project.pending.geojson until the row has a ProjectID; then add its ROUTE_CANDIDATE record here.

source.name: Virginia Natural Gas, Header Improvement Project map, November 2019 (Wayback copy; the original link now returns 404)

verifications.note: Virginia Natural Gas map of the Header Improvement Project, dated November 2019, read as a June 2024 Wayback copy. It shows the Transco Interconnect Pipeline (6.2 miles) and Quantico Parallel Pipe (3.3 miles) in Prince William and Fauquier counties, and the Mechanicsville Parallel Pipe (14.6 miles) in Hanover, New Kent and Charles City counties.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The current route for P5990 has two lines. Both came from the map of the earlier Header Improvement Project, which is now staged as its own row. The VNG Interconnect was only the northern part, in Prince William and Fauquier counties, so this candidate keeps the northern line and drops the southern line near Mechanicsville. The full two-line route moves to the Header Improvement Project row. The geometry is the same rough line as before, so the accuracy stays low.

proposed_sheet.RouteNotes: CB: northern line of the Header Improvement Project map kept; the southern line belongs to the separate Header Improvement Project row

provenance.text: The route keeps the northern line of the existing P5990 route, which was traced from Virginia Natural Gas's November 2019 Header Improvement Project map. No new coordinates were drawn.
